brief: The viewer sees a realistic, aged texture of vintage paper covering the canvas. A continuous, spontaneous stream of text characters appears and flows perpetually across the surface, generating an endless, shifting river of words. As the text accumulates, the physical stress is rendered visibly: the paper warps, creases, and the natural fibers begin to fray, pulling away from the printed characters. This decay process unfolds perpetually, mapping the passage of time and the material exhaustion of the surface.

statement: This sketch simulates the passage of time on a vintage paper surface by rendering a continuous stream of text characters that flow across the canvas. As the characters accumulate, they subtly distort the paper's appearance through warping and creasing effects, while small fibers fray away from the printed words, suggesting physical exhaustion. The visual decay is rendered in real-time, creating an endless, evolving narrative on an aging surface where the medium itself becomes part of the story.
